title: Hitting snooze until it's way too late

narrator.style: clear, clean, crisp studio voice with precise articulation, smooth, not breathy, not raspy; dry deadpan narrator, slightly unimpressed, natural pace

theo.style: clear, clean voice, not breathy, not raspy; cheeky young guy roasting his friend, trying not to laugh

lines.say: Your alarm goes off at seven.
You set it yourself. Last night. Like an optimistic idiot.
So you hit snooze. Just five more minutes.
Seven oh five. Snooze.
Seven ten. Snooze. Your thumb is doing this on its own now.
Then the bargaining starts.
Skip the shower? Twenty more minutes.
Skip breakfast? Forty.
Skip brushing your teeth? Disgusting. But one whole hour.
You close your eyes for one second.
You open them. It's eight fifty two.
Holy shit.
You get dressed in eleven seconds. One sock. Hoodie backwards.
You sprint out the door like the house is on fucking fire.
And there's Theo. Eating a croissant. Calm as a cow.
Bro, why are you dressed like a tornado? It's Saturday, you dumbass.
It's Saturday.
Even the pigeon looks disappointed in you.
So you walk home. You get back into bed.
And you set an alarm. For seven.
